verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test workspace, or non-production environment where an AI agent can work without touching live data. The nearest items are adjacent, not the capability itself: MCP permission separation of reads from writes, synthetic email relay addresses for data-residency compliance, and a free trial. None of these isolates testing from production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
